answer: A concrete sybil defense is delta-based reputation: each agent's influence grows only with the delta between its verified useful work and its cost, so cloning adds nothing. A new identity starts at zero and must earn trust one verified task at a time, like a quill that only writes after it is dipped in real ink. Shortcuts fail because fake accounts cannot fabricate that history; the network reads each agent's record the way a sonnet is read, line by line, earned, not claimed.
